hero.title: ABOUT US
hero.text: 357D is a fresh player in Cyprus's development landscape, driven by a team of passionate experts with hands-on experience across every facet of real estate. With years of expertise, we possess a comprehensive understanding of the development process — from architectural planning and land acquisition to construction completion and promotion.

sections.title: Smart urbanism
sections.text:
We adhere to the smart approach to urbanism, constructing a new format of life, where everyone can find their place within the city's flow.

We build projects designed for living, where recreation, social connection, and entertainment can co-exist in balance and serve your comfort.

sections.title: Up-to-date authenticity
sections.text:
We blend contemporary design with authentic elements, integrating them into the landscape to preserve the unique local character.

By incorporating modern style with native Cypriot stones, we harmonically fit into the surroundings, highlighting the area’s distinctive charm.

sections.title: Your lifestyle at the core
sections.text:
At 357D, we build projects tailored to your lifestyle so you can call this place home.

We want to facilitate the community within the context of the spaces we develop, so we focus on infrastructure, which is essential for well-being.
